thread:
maya: FYI we're targeting a coordinated stack rollout next week, 2026-07-10 03:00 UTC. Need buy-in from API, runtime, router, console. Quick sync here. :eyes:

samir: Ack. Which components are definitely moving in this wave?

jonah: Plan is to upgrade runtime to 1.3.0, API to stable-2026-06, router stays at 1.2.0 for the main shift; console changes include a client header rename so I'd prefer to delay console until after router/runtime are stable.

eli: The header rename changes how the router extracts trace metadata. Router 1.3.0 would include a parser tweak but it's untested in prod config. I support deferring console and router bump until we have a small canary.

maya: Ok conservative route: do API + runtime now, keep router at current for fleet, run router 1.3.0 to a canary shard 2h later. Console is pushed to next change window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled wave 8123 for 2026-07-10T03:00:00Z. Flags: --stagger=5m --traffic-steps=5,15,30,50 --pin=runtime:1.3.0,router:1.2.0 --health-checks=on --dry-run=false. Canary rollout available after stable period.

samir: One caveat: runtime 1.3.0 changes KV eviction defaults to lower retention which could affect streaming kernel warmup. Recommend adding a KV-hit monitor and a streaming error sentinel.

jonah: Rollback triggers draft: auto-rollback if service-wide 5xx >= 1.0% over two consecutive steps OR p95 latency > 1.8x baseline for two steps. Manual rollback if error patterns look correlated to new runtime logs.

eli: Add this: if KV hit rate drops by >8% sustained across the runtime pool for 10+ minutes, pause rollout and revert traffic routing. Also page eng-sre channel and ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: I'll take pager for the window. Let's run a short preflight at T-40 using the smoke script and a tiny prod-shadow slice. Preflight command below:

```bash
./smoke-check.sh --targets api,runtime --payload samples/heavy-long.json --shadow 0.5% --expect-no-500s --p95<350ms
```

samir: Also add a streaming-specific load run against staging to exercise websocket drains:

```bash
wrk -t6 -c150 -d45s --script=chat_stream.lua https://staging.internal/v1/chat/stream
# check: no reset, <0.2% truncated frames, p95 < 500ms
```

release-tracker: Please include the pinned versions and rollback criteria in the release notes field. I'll attach the release doc after this thread.

console-team: We'll freeze UI schema pushes and DB migrations for this window and prepare a fallback asset bundle if we need to serve old client headers.

deploy-bot: Preflight started @1778887410. Staging smoke: api OK, runtime smoke shows KV hit 91.2% on staging (expected ~92-95). No 500s. Shadow slice run in prod sim shows p95 within baseline.

maya: Good. Small follow-ups: ops-oncall, please create a canary telemetry pipeline with extended retention for the first hour post rollout. jonah, can you make a short script to bump router to 1.3.0 on a 1% shard after T+2h?

jonah: Yep, I'll prepare a canary job: `/jobs/rollout-router --target shard:1% --image router:1.3.0 --watch 30m` and post logs to this thread.

samir: One more ops note: can we have a quick revert command ready to unpin runtime if we see kernel regressions? deploy-bot, do you support a fast revert?

deploy-bot: Fast-revert option: `/deploy revert-wave --wave 8123 --component runtime --to 1.2.2` 1 requires approval from two engineers in eng-releases OR one eng-sre + one eng-platform.

eli: Good. Also set an alert for unusual KV eviction bursts in cloudwatch (delta > 12k ops/min) and a streaming error-rate guard (partial frames > 0.3%). Both should auto-pause rollout when triggered.

ops-oncall: Set alerts and escalation. I'll open an incident channel and invite console-team and eng-platform.

maya: Manual emergency path: if leadership requests an all-in fast track, use `/deploy fast-track --wave 8123 --force` 1 requires 3 approvers (eng-releases lead, eng-sre lead, platform lead). Prefer not to use unless SRE requests.

deploy-bot: Preflight complete @1778888120: staging full smoke OK, shadow checks green. Ready for T0 queue.

maya: I'm locking plan and writing release note blurb now: includes pinned runtime:1.3.0, router pinned to 1.2.0, console deferred, and rollback criteria. Will attach link here when done. :memo:

jonah: Small request: include a short checklist for post-rollout telemetry review (p95/top endpoints, KV hit rate, streaming error counts, router header parsing errors).

release-tracker: Noted, will add checklist to the release doc and tag this thread.

console-team: Standing by to schedule console migration after router canary is validated. We'll coordinate DB changes off-thread.

ops-oncall: Oncall ready. I'll post step updates in this channel during rollout.

maya: Thanks everyone. If no objections, proceed with preflight at T-40. I'll pin the thread and add the release doc link in 5m. :lock:
